svg.title: An inclusion proof for d3
svg.desc: To prove d3 is in the 7-entry tree, the log sends three hashes: c, g and l. The verifier computes d = H(00 || d3), then h = H(01 || c || d), then k = H(01 || g || h), then root = H(01 || k || l), and compares with the signed root.

text.tspan: the log sends [ c, g, l ], in red
the verifier computes the blue path and compares the root
three hashes for seven entries. a billion entries: thirty.
